entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about my recent purchase of a VeloBand GPS Tracker. I need to see about returning it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I'm on the right track, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's definitely a preference thing. The band works great, but I've basically just **changed my mind** about it. It was an **impulse buy** during the holidays, and I just **don't use it**.
I understand. Thanks for clarifying. Let me pull up your account and take a look at our return options for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered 24 days ago, on December 26th. Let me just check the policy here.
Alright, I've got it. It looks like you're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. I also see you're a VIP member with us, which is great.
Oh, 10 days? That's fantastic. I was worried it had been too long and was prepared to see if we could negotiate a partial credit or something.

No need for that at all. We can process a full refund. I've gone ahead and authorized the return. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just pack everything back in the original box and use that label to send it back to us.
Wow, that was incredibly simple. Thank you so much, David. I really appreciate how easy you made that.
It's my pleasure. We always want to take care of our customers. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Nope, that was it. Thanks again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
